description: This file defines the Catalyst controller for managing articles within the Coocook project. It includes actions for listing, creating, editing, updating, and deleting articles, as well as private helper methods for fetching related data and associated recipes/dishes.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Article
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for managing article-related actions in the Coocook project.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GET/HEAD requests to list articles, fetches project data, and prepares articles with tags, units, and URLs for display.

methods.name: new_article
methods.description: Displays the form for creating a new article.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures an article by ID and stashes it for further actions.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares data for editing an existing article.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new article related to the project.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an article if it is not used in dishes or recipes.

methods.name: fetch_project_data
methods.description: Fetches and prepares project-related data such as tags, units, and shop sections for forms.

methods.name: dishes_recipes
methods.description: Collects related dishes and recipes linked to the article.

methods.name: update_or_insert
methods.description: Handles the logic for updating or inserting an article, including tags and units.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects to the articles index page.
